settings.heading: A clear view of the preview.
settings.body: Design presentation and release approval are separate milestones.

settings.heading: Available to explore.
settings.body: The showroom, native layout examples and nine historical brand demos are available; EVERREAL is paused for costume imagery review. The available demos can be opened through the links in this site. Theme-specific views preserve the original demo resources.

settings.heading: What this preview does not promise.
settings.body: This is not a Theme Store approval, performance certification or commercial launch announcement. Demo products may be fictional or sold out. Search covers the shared demo catalog. Account and checkout behavior depend on the store configuration.

settings.heading: Before a release.
settings.body: The final brand assets, complete functional and responsive review, performance and accessibility checks, preset packaging, documentation and owner release approval remain part of the launch process.
